newsitem.title: UK: Norex Industries approved for Oslo listing.
newsitem.headline: Norex Industries approved for Oslo listing.

text.p: Oslo Stock Exchange (OSE) today said it has approved an application from US offshore and shipping investment company Norex Industries Inc for a secondary listing of the company's common shares on its main list.
The move represents the first OSE listing of an investment company specialising in the shipping and offshore sectors, it added.
Norex Industries (formerly known as Norex America) has investments in several Oslo-listed companies including Det Sondenfjelds-Norske Dampskibsselkab ASA, NCL Holding ASA and Transocean Holdings Bhd.
The application has been approved on condition that Norex Industries provides an introductory prospectus which fulfills OSE regulations, the exchange said.

OSE said the listing will give Norex Industries a public market for shareholders of about 70% of the company's common shares not registered by the US Securities and Exchange Commission and therefore not available for sale in the US.
Norex Industries brings to 11 the number of non-Norwegian companies within the shipping and offshore sector listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
